investigations.name: tumor-tcell-showcase
investigations.title: Tumor–T-cell Microenvironment (Vivarium 1.0 → 2.0 migration)
investigations.question:
Does migrating the tumor-tcell agent-based model from Vivarium 1.0 to process-bigraph
(Vivarium 2.0) reproduce the paper's mechanism, and which parts of that mechanism hold
robustly at a tractable scale (tens of cells, tens of simulated hours)?
investigations.hypothesis:
Active (PD1-) T cells in contact with tumor cells secrete IFNg and cytotoxic packets.
IFNg diffuses and drives proliferative PDL1n tumors toward the arrested PDL1p state;
cumulative cytotoxic delivery kills tumor cells; and T cells that engage too long become
exhausted (PD1+) and secrete less. The T-cell-intrinsic and cytokine steps should hold at
reduced scale; the slower population-level killing/conversion effects may need paper scale.
